SVRUNR

The National Weather Service in Rapid City has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
East Central Crook County in northeastern Wyoming...

* Until 1045 PM MDT.

* At 956 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Alva, or 18
miles north of Sundance, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Beulah, Alva, Aladdin, Bear Lodge Campground, Cook Lake and Warren
Peak.

This includes Interstate 90 in Wyoming between Mile Markers 189 and
207.

suddenly higher waves. Large hail could result in
structural damage.
